name: spark-one-08-illusions-eval
cmd: BANK=data/generated/illusions python3 -m spark_one.hf_predict --model google/gemma-4-E2B-it --adapter runs/gemma-e2b-lora-v1/final_adapter --bank data/generated/illusions --split test --out runs/gemma-e2b-lora-v1/illusions/test_preds.jsonl --no-variants && python3 -m spark_one.eval.harness --bank data/generated/illusions --preds runs/gemma-e2b-lora-v1/illusions/test_preds.jsonl --temps runs/gemma-e2b-lora-v1/eval/temps.json --out runs/gemma-e2b-lora-v1/illusions --name 'Spark-1 on optical illusions'
